notes: §1985:IX.3.2.4 GR4: "The LABEL RECORDS clause for the Indexed I-O module is the same as the LABEL RECORDS clause for the Sequential I-O module. Thus the specifications for the LABEL RECORDS clause are located on page VII-26." Implemented at 85: one grammar rule (labelRecordsClause), admitted in every file description format by its FileDescriptionFormats.Rows row, serves the indexed FD, and VisitLabelRecordsClause is the edition arm (accepted at --std 85, refused from 2002); STANDARD and OMITTED are accepted and nothing is bound, which is all a host file with no label records needs (§1985:VII.3.6.3 GR2 leaves the labels to "the implementor's label specifications"). Not implemented: the rest of the specifications the rule points to. The grammar takes STANDARD, OMITTED or any words and no binder reads the clause, so the general format's two options (§1985:VII.3.6.2) are not enforced: on an indexed file LABEL RECORDS ARE IGNORED and LABEL RECORD IS a data-name compile and run at 85. §1985:VII.3.6.3 GR4 (the clauses of an external file connector "must have the same specification") is not asked either: probed, two programs' EXTERNAL indexed FDs, one STANDARD and one OMITTED, compile and run. kb/Work PB5070 holds the first mechanism (filed against the report FD's format, 1985-FMT-XIII.3.2.2) and PB5069 the unchecked external agreement; neither lists this rule id. The witness is an indexed FD with LABEL RECORDS ARE STANDARD.

next.reason: 1985: "The LABEL RECORDS clause for the Indexed I-O module is the same as the LABEL RECORDS clause for the Sequential I-O module."; 2023: "No LABEL RECORDS clause in 2023 file description entry rules; obsolete element deleted". LABEL RECORDS was obsolete and slated for deletion. None of the 2023 file description candidates mentions it, so 2023 lacks the clause.
